synthesis.agreement: Second editorial pass remains clean. Return after midnight but before Thursday dawn meets the formal deadline; missing dawn causes embarrassment without preventing departure. The ghost audience requires both an arranged reading and notification, so a different solution retains its actual coda. The recurring comic tasks, exact compliments, useless relics and serious NPC reactions remain intact.
tonePreservation: Preserve the serious hat inspection, all nine marrow entries, postal passenger classification, opinionated trees, cheese, eyebrow conversation and dreadful amateur theatre.
The Boots' unexplained ten minutes, approximately north-ish Ring, doubtful Sword and invisible left elbow remain intentional comic effects. Do not rationalize or improve them.
No generic escape routes, logistical timetables or new safety speeches are requested. Existing comic gate conditions remain playable as authored.
dissent: Bert may prefer useful loot and Nan may prefer gentler danger; those tastes do not govern this absurd adventure.
Rosa's audio questions need listening evidence; no pacing verdict is inferred from scene count.
Ines values stable comic rules and Gerry values actual-choice closure; neither calls for plausible real-world logistics.
synthesis.limits: Textual case analysis only: no execution of gameplay, audio, narration or deadline handling. All four baseline findings remain resolved, and no additional edit is justified merely by the review count.
